The well-rounded team has each runner completing their 400-meter leg in 55 seconds, so their total time is \(4 \times 55 = 220\) seconds.

The less well-rounded team has runners with times: 60 seconds, \(60 - 3 = 57\) seconds, \(57 - 3 = 54\) seconds, and \(54 - 3 = 51\) seconds. Their total time is \(60 + 57 + 54 + 51 = 222\) seconds.

The faster team wins by \(222 - 220 = 2\) seconds.

Answer: 2
